name: JoinGonka Gateway
description: Gateway to Gonka-served GLM, DeepSeek and MiniMax with 3M tokens free.
overview: JoinGonka Gateway serves the Gonka network's open models through one OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible key at gate.joingonka.ai/v1, and new accounts get 3,000,000 free tokens on registration. It advertises GLM-5.3-Flash at $0.0058 per million tokens against $0.15 on OpenRouter, charges a 10% usage fee over network cost, and bundles web search, JSON healing and PDF parsing as request plugins. Registration takes about thirty seconds and no card or KYC is required.
free_access: No card, no KYC; key in about 30 seconds
OpenAI and Anthropic compatible, works with Claude Code and Codex CLI
Web search, JSON healing and PDF parsing as request plugins
notes: One of several independent Gonka resellers, each with its own signup and its own grant — see Dahl, Gonka24 and GonkaRouter. Prices track a decentralised network, so availability moves.
